lu.info.shirt: Every man in the room hangs the club's shirt of {year}. A shirt can never tell you who started.
lu.info.shirtPlain: The archive has no shirt for this night, so every man hangs the club's own colours.
lu.info.bands: Bands are your own arrangement. The archive records who started, not where each man stood, so only the names are graded and no formation is implied.
lu.prompt.start: Tap a shirt to hang it in {band} — or drag it up onto the board.
lu.prompt.man: {name}: lock him, send him back, or tap another band to move him.
lu.prompt.full: Eleven on the board. Hand in the team sheet when you are sure.
lu.prompt.full12: Eleven are already on the board. Send one back to make room.
lu.prompt.graded: The sheet is in. Here is who really started.
lu.rack.title: Lockers
lu.rack.list: Lockers: every man of the night
lu.rack.ariaTaken: {name}: already on the board — select him
lu.lock.full: Three locks are already staked. Unlock one first.
lu.coach.title: The coach's note
lu.coach.hint: The coach counts. He never names a man and never names a band.
lu.coach.need: Put at least one man on the board first.
lu.coach.stillOut: {n} of the starting eleven are still not on your sheet.
lu.coach.benchOn: {n} of your {of} men were substitutes, not starters.
lu.coach.spent: No more notes — the coach has said what he will.
lu.handin.title: Hand in the team sheet?
lu.handin.body: Once it is in, the sheet is graded and you see who really started. Nothing is shown before.
lu.rules.title: How the dressing room works
lu.rules.1: Eleven men started this match. Hang eleven on the board — the lockers hold them and the decoys.
lu.rules.2: Tap a band, then a shirt; or tap a shirt and it goes to the aimed band; or drag a shirt up onto any band.
lu.rules.3: Lock up to three men you would stake your word on. A lock never changes your score — it shows how sure you were.
lu.rules.4: The coach counts but never names. Names are shown only after you hand the sheet in.
lu.result.title: The result
lu.result.keep: Study the archive and try again.
lu.result.missed: In the XI, not on your sheet
lu.onlyOne: This club has one line-up match so far, so the next round is this one again.
lu.share.title: My team sheet
lu.mode.name: Name practice
lu.mode.note: Name practice: only who started is graded. This archive records no bands for the match, so no band accuracy is claimed.
lu.intro.title: Name the eleven who started
lu.intro.body: Hang eleven men on the four-band board from the locker room. The lockers hold the eleven and decoys from the same era.
lu.intro.rule1: Eleven places, each man once. Undo any move before you hand in.
lu.intro.rule2: Up to 3 locks and up to 2 coach notes. No clock.
lu.intro.rule3: Name practice: names are graded, bands are your own arrangement and are not scored.
